semiconductor_relevance: High — A-SAT Corporation provides a range of semiconductor manufacturing tools and inspection equipment, indicating a strong relevance to the semiconductor industry.
summary: A-SAT Corporation specializes in semiconductor manufacturing tools, ancillary facilities, and inspection equipment, offering total solutions for various semiconductor processes. Their product lineup includes advanced etching equipment and metrology tools, catering to the needs of semiconductor fabrication and inspection.
capabilities: ICP Etch for CMOS and MEMS applications
MOCVD Epi for GaN and SiC films
Metrology for film thickness using Ellipsometry

regional_presence.Singapore: A-SAT Corporation collaborates with ASETS (Advanced Semiconductor Equipment Technology Singapore Pte. Ltd) to provide equipment and solutions in the region.
